notes.title: Update to Version 0.8.0.1 - 11 September 2024
notes.notes:
Hello!

This update includes completely changed negotiation systems for each individual negotiation. Several improvements have been made and completely new systems have been implemented.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] The input for numerical input boxes in the sponsor negotiations has been optimised.
[/list]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Integration of all new negotiation systems.
[*] There are different negotiation types for sponsors and players.
[*] A new system for the patience and mood of negotiating partners.
[*] Players being monitored are now labelled.
[*] Own players placed on the transfer list are now labelled.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
[list]
[*] The substitution screen now uses the correct strength system.
[*] The expected ticket revenue is now displayed with the correct value.
[*] The sale of single boards is no longer more lucrative than multiple boards.
[*] The contract terms of employee contracts are correct again.
[*] There are no more duplicate sponsors per sponsor type.
[*] The problems with scouting the watch list have been fixed.
[*] Automatic renewals now take effect after the correct number of matches.
[*] The settings for the game system, currency and payment of salaries are now saved correctly again.
[*] The rounding error in credit repayment has been fixed, repayment is now possible in full.
[*] Fixed a sporadic problem with duplicated players in the squad when signing them on 01 January.
[*] Fixed the incorrect collation of player lists in the squad screen.
[*] Fixed a problem with an expiring youth contract when a U23 player contract already existed.
[/list]

The changes essentially work with existing savegames, but please note:

[i]Some small things in the sponsor negotiations, such as the new values for the deduction in case of relegation, only work when new sponsor offers have been generated.[/i]

notes.title: Update to version 0.18.47.172 – 28.09.2023
notes.notes:
Hello dear Goal fans!

We have another regular update for you, which brings along some exciting new content. The AI will now occasionally substitute kickers and try to buy kickers from you as well.

Furthermore, there are significant changes in the financial system and related systems like market value calculation. However, this means that the previous save games are no longer compatible. We tried to avoid this under all circumstances, but ultimately, it was unfortunately unavoidable, and we apologise for that.

You can now have friendlies either away or at home at the start of the season or on non-game days.

Additionally, there are a plethora of adjustments and bug fixes.

[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*] Real Manager Career: Contracts can now expire.
[*] Real Manager Career: Club can fire manager.
[*] Real Manager Career: Manager can cancel contract preemptively.
[*] Real Manager Career: X in club offers now closes offer, does not remove from available negotiations.
[*] Real Manager Career: At the start of a game, you can only get offers from third league clubs.
[*] Loan interests are now paid monthly.
[*] Main sponsor rates are balanced.
[*] All sponsors now pay yearly.
[*] Recalculation of kicker market values.
[*] Transfer prices for kickers adjusted based on market value and remaining contract years.
[*] Exit clause and release on relegation clauses adjusted based on market value.
[*] Now rounding values in negotiation screens.
[*] Adjusted initial salary demand in buy kicker negotiation.
[*] Adjusted initial salary demand for kicker contract extensions.
[*] Adjusted starting capital of clubs based on prestige and league.
[*] Adjusted scouting cost.
[*] Calendar design was adjusted.
[*] Cup statistics were improved.
[*] Name pool for personnel & generated kickers (male & female).
[*] Existing formations revised.
[*] Balancing calculation real strength.
[*] Optimising AI Freshness.
[*] Adjustment of contract terms (sponsor, employee, manager, player contracts).
[*] Ball line removed in 3D game scenes.
[*] Minor UI adjustments.
[/list]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing personnel such as Co-Trainer or sales manager now also has an impact.
[*] Added maintenance costs for stadium and infrastructure.
[*] Finance details are separated by months and show previous seasons.
[*] At the end of one season 20% income tax on club profits will be due.
[*] Opponents substitute kickers.
[*] Co-Trainer substitutes kickers.
[*] Added neighbour positions for kickers.
[*] AI makes offers for user kickers who are not on the transfer list.
[*] Friendly matches.
[/list]

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]
[list]
[*] Loan interest rates fixed.
[*] Adjusted transfer market filter options for kicker without contract: Kicker with contract is the new standard setting.
[*] Fixed youth budget bug in league 3.
[*] Stadium blocks, stadium dropdowns and build durations show up correctly.
[*] Corrected incorrect texts in the stadium environment.
[*] Scouting order: wrong position TW scouted.
[*] Contractless kicker available twice on the transfer market.
[*] Scouting: free scouts watch players twice.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to Version 0.18.35.155 – 31.03.2023
notes.notes:
[h3]Content update to version 0.18.34.154 brings "Meisterpokal" as well as further improvements and bug fixes [/h3]

Hello, football fans!
The European competitions are entering the hot phase. 

And from now on you can also try to stir up Europe with your teams in Anstoss.
With the "Meisterpokal" there is now a new international tournament in which you can not only fight for honour, but also for enormous profit. 
In order to have the best possible overview not only there, but especially in the European competition, a new tournament tree view has also been added. 

However, due to the greatly improved structure of the database required for this, it is no longer possible to continue using previous saves from this point on. We apologise for this, but at the same time we have used this opportunity to lay the foundation for further competitions in the background, so that future changes here should not result in any further save game incompatibilities.

Other important content in this major content update includes optimisations to card suspensions, improvements to the co-trainer functions and numerous bug fixes.

notes.title: Update - Version 0.18.7.123 - 11.11.2022
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42040018/8d38cc85371378d9cead01dcf382951d37f98041.png[/img]

Hello Goal! fans!

Another small update for the weekend!

[h3]But before we get to the notes, something important:[/h3]

We will provide a second branch of the game throughout the Early Access. It is called “last_version”.

What is this, you ask? The principle is really simple: there are two branches of the game. One, the live version, is always available and will be updated in intervals with the latest game version.

The other branch is in a kind of a retrospect state, unless updated. Update intervals may be longer here, so you can play the game without having to start new games every few days/weeks. We will announce when "last_version" version is updated.

Both branches have their own saves and carrying a save from “last_version” to the public build may break it or may not be possible at all (read below).

[hr][/hr]

[h3] How do I take part on this branch? [/h3]

One or the other of you probably haven't done this yet, so we have a little guide:

[b] Prerequisite: [/b]

You must have Goal! in your library.

[b]The procedure[/b]
[list]
[*] Open your game library.
[*] Click on Goal! with the right mouse button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42040018/95c6f452c4ef7aa7cda10117e322a091868ceca5.png[/img]

[*] Open properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42040018/70a3883b7af9370fff1c702d8511bdbde8001374.png[/img]

[*] Select the tab "BETAS".
[*] Enter this password below the dropdown in the field: [b]clubmanagerlastversion[/b].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42040018/f3562edcec1f668350d386be80faafb178caf689.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Press CHECK CODE
[*] Use the dropdown menu and select "last_version". 
[*] Press Close.
[*] Steam should now download this version of the game.
[/list]

[i]*Steam calls all these builds "betas", although they are not necessarily betas, don't let that confuse you![/i]

[hr][/hr]

[b]A remark about the savegames[/b]

We tried to avoid it, but due to major changes in game systems we can't prevent savegames from being compatible despite our best efforts. We understand that you are disappointed about this.  And in the current optimisation process, we cannot guarantee 100% compatibility in upcoming updates this year.  However, we must consider whether the continued use of existing savegames could lead to unpleasant secondary errors that could have a negative effect on the patched game and which could cause even more difficulties or have an ongoing impact on the gaming experience.  Our goal is to ensure compatibility across the board, but in case of doubt, we will always choose playability over major issues caused by the unpredictable effects of savegame contents in the backend. Nevertheless, we will try to inform you in advance if we can anticipate that savegames cannot be used any further. 

Your save games can be found here and be secured if necessary:

AppData > LocalLow > 2tainment > GOAL> SaveGames.
Alternatively:
AppData > LocalLow > 2tainment > Anstoss> SaveGames.

[hr][/hr]

Despite all odds, we thank you for your support with savegames, logs and error descriptions. Please continue to submit them!

As always, we are currently working on further updates! 

See you next time!

The time has finally come for you to go to your job in your favourite football club. There you must fulfil no lesser task than to take your club to glory and honour. No matter what.

Goal offers you:
[list]
[*] Football presidents who will make unfulfillable desires in latent craving for status.
[*] Sponsors who would rather pay too little than too much.
[*] Spoiled hairdresser clients who are called football stars by the fans.
[*] At least 34 Rogue-like levels per season with valuable points as loot for the so-called league table.
[*] Exciting adventures in the locker room, where you can give your squad the hairdryer treatment.
[*] Indulge extensively in the materialism that comes with employment.
[/list]

Come and see the madness that the world's second favourite occupation has in store every day, rise to become one of the tough football managers who subordinate everything to success and become the autocrat of the football leagues. Take the plunge into the business of brutal tackles and unjustified penalties and get a few virtual high-profile fans and a virtual cheeky ball (Pallino and us) for free at the start of the first season.

Get the ball into the net!

notes.title: The new tactical focus
notes.notes:
Hello football fans,

you can see it on the new roadmap: There will changes regarding the further development direction for the rest of this year as well as for 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42040018/5e4d9024f944503d63b8cffa58568b0662d7b7fa.png[/img]

The absolute priority for us is that the game is performant, stable and fun to play with the content already available at the start of the Early Access phase. 
This premise was also responsible for the release delay. Our main focus was sending an entertaining as well as functional game onto the competitive pitch. 

The three weeks of additional development time have helped GOAL! in every possible way. It is more polished, it is more stable, and it is even more fun to play. However, the three weeks spent on improving and bugfixing are now missing in the schedule to add more features and content. 
Also, with the launch into Early Access, we are expecting a huge amount of player feedback. In turn, we have to channel, filter and sort this before we start working on requests, bug fixes and further balancing or optimization issues. As a result, we are running out of time for the content and feature additions we had planned for this year. 

When we add a new feature, we want it to fit seamlessly and not feel like a hastily tacked on appendix. It should work as smoothly and bug-free as possible. 

That's why we've decided to dedicate the post-launch phase of Early Access almost entirely to community feedback as well as optimizations, balancing and bug-fixing of the existing content. In the background, the feature additions are already being prepared, but we don't want to rush anything, yet release everything as quickly as possible, but also as well-functioning as possible. We'd rather take a little longer to develop, but with a decent result.

We will keep you informed about the progress in the next weeks and months and wish you a lot of fun with GOAL! The Club Manager.

The teams of 
2tainment and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: Two days to kick-off!
notes.notes:
Hello football fans!

Just a few more days - and then Goal! The Club Manager will be released in Early Access.

We want to say thank you ahead of time. For all your patience and the support we felt over the last few weeks.

It was a rocky road. And in the case of the short notice release delay it was very painful. 
But we also know, how long you've been patiently waiting, to feel and play the re-imagining of one the Germany's most prolific franchises.

We could spend more days and weeks on fixing bugs, adding more features, testing those features, fixing bugs etc.

But we don't want you to wait any longer.
At the same time we feel and hope, that the current feature set will entertain you for dozens of hours, while you are trying to prepare your team for the tasks ahead and try to put your club on a financially sound foundation.

This is, why now seems to be the right moment in time, to let you all in. We are looking forward to your feedback. This is extremely important and vital to us, in order to align our next development steps with you, to honor your wishes and to see, how we can connect them with our vision of a modern football management game.

With absolute certainty, you will find the occasional bug and probably pixels who seem odd. A lot of what you'll discover we probably know already and are working on it. Some of what you might discover, could be a first. But regardless of new or already reported, we'll try to fix as many bugs as fast as possible.

But we will also add new features and more content.
For Early Access start there are national teams or international cup competition missing, for example. Those will be delivered as soon as possible, while we continue to update the roadmap.

We are looking forward to welcoming you to the world of Goal! The Club Manager in two days!!

The teams from
2tainment and Toplitz Productions

notes.title: GOAL! The Club Manager: Development Goes into Extra Time
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

More time needed to deliver best possible gaming experience – release postponed to November 2nd

It’s the same every year. The season opener is scheduled, and fans begin to make their way to the stadium in anticipation of their team’s first match. They grab their seats in a sold-out stadium, nervous for kick-off. Instead of the whistle being blown and the roar of the crowd rolling out, the turnstiles are closed, and kick-off has been canceled. It’s time to return home.

The kick-off of GOAL! The Club Manager can’t quite begin. Developer 2tainment and publisher Toplitz Productions have to announce the release of the football management sim has to be postponed on short notice. Unexpected problems have arisen in the final testing phase, which make the originally planned release on 13 October impossible. Instead, the game will now be released on [b]2 November 2022.[/b]

In a joint statement, 2tainment and Toplitz Productions address the fans: "We have worked tirelessly for you over the past days and nights, improving features and fixing bugs. Unfortunately, a blocker has crept in that we are not able to solve in time. Thus, we have decided to postpone the release by a few weeks to give you the best possible experience."

notes.title: Changes in the feature list??? Say what?
notes.notes:
Hello football fans,

you might have noticed that there have been slight changes in the feature list for GOAL! The Club Manager.

There is nothing to worry about, though. With the Early Access release date closing in, we just wanted the features to be as accurate as possible. To achieve that we added a sidenote if that feature will be available during the Early Access phase, wherever applicable.

But everything that we set out to include either in Early Access or further down the road, is still planned and all the major features that didn't make it into the game at launch will be shown in a roadmap that we will release together with the game on October 13.

We are looking forward to seeing you in GOAL! The Club Manager and being a part of a very vivid community.

Talk soon!

The 2tainment and Toplitz Productions teams

notes.title: Goal! - The Club Manager - A glimpse into the game!
notes.notes:
"The show must go on".

Smiling broadly, you get out of the car that has just taken you to the car park of your new sports venue. You lift your sunglasses and look out at the masses of people expecting you to be the new saviour for their club. Just twelve people are standing there.

You hurry past a 7-year-old fan in a baseball cap and scarf, signing his autograph pad with three crosses. Let's see if it's worth perfecting your signature some other time. 
You are nimbly taken to the club boss's office, where they expect nothing less from you than to win the championship. You correctly set fifteen signatures this time and the adventure begins. That is exactly what you came for!

Yes, dear friend of cultivated chessboard tactics and admirer of false 9’s and swapping wingmen, soon the time will come. Then it will be up to you to prevent the storming of the pitch with subsequent public tarring and feathering and instead collect golden trophies for the display case!

But first you must watch this video!
